findings.evidence:
The working directory is the repository root, so `.gitignore` and the
  path being ignored are both relative to it.
findings.note: This is asserted as an assumption but the Procedure contains no step to confirm or cd to the repo root, so a fresh instance invoked from any subdirectory will silently append to or create the wrong .gitignore file with no error raised.

findings.evidence:
Run before step 1 it exits 1; run after step 1 it exits 0, on the same
  working tree.
findings.note: This states a universal pre/post behavior, but check-ignore can already return 0 before step 1 if a parent .gitignore, core.excludesFile, or an existing broader pattern already matches the path, making the claimed differential unreliable in some repos even though the post-step-1 check itself remains valid.
